upkeep.desc: What the army costs to keep (multiplier)

bleed.desc: How many men his army loses in battle (multiplier)

breakthrough.desc: The advantage his army needs to break through the enemy's lines in one battle (multiplier)

hold.desc: Share of enemy advances into his land that he stops

homeFight.desc: How hard his army fights in a war over his nation's own land (multiplier)

garrison.desc: How hard his army fights uprisings (multiplier)

earns.desc: Gold a year: taxes, factory output and sea trade (multiplier)

ownTaxes.desc: Taxes from his own people's provinces (multiplier)

reformCalm.desc: How much unrest reforms take away (multiplier)

unrest.desc: Unrest added everywhere during his reign

unrestOwn.desc: Unrest added in his own people's provinces during his reign

unrestOther.desc: Unrest added in other peoples' provinces during his reign

bias.desc: How much better he believes his odds in war are than they are

swing.desc: How far his belief about his odds in war swings, either way, redrawn every season

sharp.desc: Share of his misjudgment of his odds in war that he sees through

horizon.desc: Years added to how far ahead he plans

integrateOther.desc: How fast other peoples' provinces become integrated (multiplier)

army.desc: Thousands of men added to the army at his coronation

factoryCapital.desc: Factories added in the capital at his coronation

factoryRandom.desc: Factories added in a random province at his coronation

fortify.desc: Random provinces fortified at his coronation

calmAll.desc: Unrest taken away everywhere at his coronation

calmOwn.desc: Unrest taken away in his own people's provinces at his coronation

calmOther.desc: Unrest taken away in other peoples' provinces at his coronation

reforms.desc: Free reforms passed at his coronation

truce.desc: Years of truce with every neighbour from his coronation

rights.desc: Random peoples of the realm accepted for good at his coronation

province.desc: Random bordering provinces that become his at his coronation

endGold.desc: Share of the gold he leaves that is spent when his reign ends

civilWar.desc: His reign always ends in civil war, adding this much unrest everywhere

endUnrestOther.desc: Unrest added in other peoples' provinces when his reign ends

targetFight.desc: Fighting strength against the advance’s named nation only (multiplier)
